001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * IOB snapshot written when a BLE, pump-UI or Control-IQ bolus is initiated, before the bolus
009 * is delivered; {@link IobSnapshotPostBolusHistoryLog} is its counterpart at completion.
010 *
011 * <p>Both IOB models the pump tracks are recorded, whichever one it displays. On pumps that
012 * answered ControlIQIOBRequest within 90 s of the record, {@link #getMudaliarIob()} equalled
013 * mudaliarIOB and {@link #getSwan6hrIob()} equalled swan6hrIOB, to the milliunit. Tandem publishes
014 * no name for opcode 206, so this class name is provisional.
015 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/143.
016 */
017
018/**
019 * History log record IOB Snapshot Before Bolus, opCode 206, size 26.
020 *
021 * <br>
022 *
023 * IOB snapshot written when a BLE, pump-UI or Control-IQ bolus is initiated, before the bolus
024 * is delivered; {@link IobSnapshotPostBolusHistoryLog} is its counterpart at completion.
025 *
026 * <p>Both IOB models the pump tracks are recorded, whichever one it displays. On pumps that
027 * answered ControlIQIOBRequest within 90 s of the record, {@link #getMudaliarIob()} equalled
028 * mudaliarIOB and {@link #getSwan6hrIob()} equalled swan6hrIOB, to the milliunit. Tandem publishes
029 * no name for opcode 206, so this class name is provisional.
030 * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/143.
031 *
032 * 
033 * <table border='1'>
034 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
035 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>206</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
036 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"IOB Snapshot Before Bolus"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
037 * </table>
038 */@HistoryLogProps(
039    opCode = 206,
040    displayName = "IOB Snapshot Before Bolus"
041)
042public class IobSnapshotPreBolusHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
043
044    private int bolusId;
045    private int unknownU8At12;
046    private int selectedIob;
047    private float mudaliarIob;
048    private float swan6hrIob;
049    private float unknownFloatAt22;
050
051    public IobSnapshotPreBolusHistoryLog() {}
052
053    public IobSnapshotPreBolusHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int selectedIob, float mudaliarIob, float swan6hrIob, float unknownFloatAt22) {
054        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, unknownU8At12, selectedIob, mudaliarIob, swan6hrIob, unknownFloatAt22, 0);
055    }
056
057    public IobSnapshotPreBolusHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int selectedIob, float mudaliarIob, float swan6hrIob, float unknownFloatAt22, int headerHighNibble) {
058        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
059        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, unknownU8At12, selectedIob, mudaliarIob, swan6hrIob, unknownFloatAt22, headerHighNibble);
060        this.bolusId = bolusId;
061        this.unknownU8At12 = unknownU8At12;
062        this.selectedIob = selectedIob;
063        this.mudaliarIob = mudaliarIob;
064        this.swan6hrIob = swan6hrIob;
065        this.unknownFloatAt22 = unknownFloatAt22;
066    }
067
068    public int typeId() {
069        return 206;
070    }
071
072    /**
073     * <table border="1">
074     * <caption>Parsed fields for IobSnapshotPreBolusHistoryLog:</caption>
075     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
076     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At12</code></td><td><code>raw[12] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
077     * <tr><td><code>selectedIob</code></td><td><code>raw[13] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
078     * <tr><td><code>mudaliarIob</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
079     * <tr><td><code>swan6hrIob</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
080     * <tr><td><code>unknownFloatAt22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
081     * </table>
082     */
083    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
084        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
085        this.cargo = raw;
086        parseBase(raw);
087        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
088        this.unknownU8At12 = raw[12] & 0xFF;
089        this.selectedIob = raw[13] & 0xFF;
090        this.mudaliarIob = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
091        this.swan6hrIob = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
092        this.unknownFloatAt22 = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22);
093    }
094
095    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int selectedIob, float mudaliarIob, float swan6hrIob, float unknownFloatAt22, int headerHighNibble) {
096        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
097            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(206, headerHighNibble),
098            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
099            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
100            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId),
101            new byte[]{ (byte) unknownU8At12, (byte) selectedIob },
102            Bytes.toFloat(mudaliarIob),
103            Bytes.toFloat(swan6hrIob),
104            Bytes.toFloat(unknownFloatAt22)));
105    }
106
107    public int getBolusId() {
108        return bolusId;
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * @return byte 12. Meaning unknown: 1 on every Control-IQ-off pump observed, 3 on most
113     * records from pumps running Control-IQ, and occasionally 2 or 0.
114     */
115    public int getUnknownU8At12() {
116        return unknownU8At12;
117    }
118
119    /**
120     * @return the IOB model the pump displays: equal to
121     * {@link BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog#getSelectedIOB()} and to byte 12 of
122     * {@link BolusActivatedHistoryLog} for the same bolus in every record observed
123     */
124    public int getSelectedIob() {
125        return selectedIob;
126    }
127
128    public BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog.SelectedIOBType getSelectedIobType() {
129        return BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog.SelectedIOBType.fromId(selectedIob);
130    }
131
132    /**
133     * @return IOB in units under the pump's Mudaliar model, whose decay follows the profile's
134     * insulin duration. When {@link #getSelectedIob()} is 0 this is the IOB
135     * shown on the pump.
136     */
137    public float getMudaliarIob() {
138        return mudaliarIob;
139    }
140
141    /**
142     * @return IOB in units under the pump's Swan 6-hour model (ControlIQIOBResponse.swan6hrIOB).
143     * When {@link #getSelectedIob()} is 1 this is the IOB shown
144     * on the pump.
145     */
146    public float getSwan6hrIob() {
147        return swan6hrIob;
148    }
149
150    /**
151     * @return a third IOB-like value in units, of unidentified model. It is usually below
152     * {@link #getSwan6hrIob()} and decays faster. Like the Swan value, and unlike the Mudaliar
153     * one, it usually rises by exactly the delivered amount between the pre- and post-bolus
154     * snapshots of one bolus.
155     */
156    public float getUnknownFloatAt22() {
157        return unknownFloatAt22;
158    }
159}
